title: Mikayla's Wallet News Bot
sub: Automated financial news → narrated video pipeline · 2026 → now
description: A fully automated content pipeline that turns daily financial news into short-form explainer videos. Pulls top stories via NewsMesh, uses Claude to score each one for 'wallet impact' (prices, interest rates, jobs, cost of living), generates a narrated script, converts it to speech with Fish Audio TTS, and assembles a video — optionally with an AI lip-synced avatar via Replicate — before publishing to YouTube. Nothing goes live without human approval: a password-gated admin dashboard lets a reviewer approve or reject each video, with a full audit trail and automatic S3 cleanup on rejection. Built solo across 4 deployed services — a Python pipeline worker, a FastAPI backend, an internal React/TypeScript admin dashboard (review queue, cost tracking, API call logs, scheduling settings), and a sanitized public-facing gallery — all on Postgres and Railway, with built-in per-call API cost tracking and observability.

title: Mikayla's Weather Bot
sub: NYC daily-high forecasts vs. Kalshi markets · paper trading · 2026 → now
description: A weather-forecasting trading bot that pulls NWS forecasts and Kalshi KXHIGHNY market odds for NYC daily highs, compares model probability against market pricing, and paper-trades the edge on a schedule. Full-stack — FastAPI backend with scheduled ingestion/settlement crons, a Postgres store, and a Next.js dashboard for live weather, forecast drift, and simulated wallet performance.

title: Presnt — Extracurricular Attendance & Compliance Platform
sub: Attendance tracking, dues, compliance, event management · 2025 → now
description: A full-stack mobile + web platform built for organizations to manage event attendance, member compliance, dues, and chapter oversight. Features passive geofence check-in, QR code scanning, role-based access, real-time notifications, and a multi-org hierarchy. Built end-to-end — Supabase schema with RLS, Express API, React Native mobile app, and a web dashboard.
